The '''leather jerkin''' was one of the oldest forms of [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. It was made for centuries and could be custom-fit for a small charge. Members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Force]] wore variations of this type of light armor; these were typically officers who served on the security details of dignitaries. [[Captain/Legends|Captains]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] and [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] wore such jerkins when guarding [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] and later [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].
